prompt.v: A rectangle is 1 cm longer than it is wide, and its perimeter is 34 cm. Which equation gives the width, w?

problems.text: equation for: A rectangle is 1 cm longer than it is wide, and its perimeter is 34 cm. Which equation gives the width, w?
